item.title: March is 'Art Gallery Month' in San Diego
item.description: Thirteen independent galleries in San Diego are participating in "Art Gallery Month" to celebrate local artists and provide the public with the opportunity to explore art galleries.

item.title: San Diego-based aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln involved in Iran attack
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln, homeported in San Diego, played a key role in a coordinated US-Israeli operation against Iran's nuclear program, which included aerial and naval strikes targeting Iranian military infrastructure.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in hit-and-run near SeaWorld San Diego
item.description: A pedestrian was killed in a hit-and-run crash in the Mission Bay Park area early Sunday morning, and the driver fled the scene, continuing southbound after the collision.

item.title: Three US service members killed, five seriously wounded in Iran operation: Military
item.description: They are the first reported American casualties since the U.S. and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran.

item.title: Man stabbed during funeral service at San Diego church
item.description: A man in his 40s was seriously injured after being stabbed multiple times during a funeral service at a church in San Diego's Colina Del Sol neighborhood on Saturday, and a man in his late 20s was detained at the scene.

item.title: 'Indicators' of possible terrorism in deadly Austin mass shooting: FBI
item.description: Two people are dead and 14 more are injured after the early morning shooting. The alleged gunman was fatally shot by officers, according to authorities.

item.title: Woman found dead inside San Diego apartment; boyfriend arrested
item.description: A woman in her 30s was found dead in a Colina Del Sol apartment early Saturday morning, and her boyfriend was arrested in connection with her death.

item.title: Carlsbad police investigate downtown stabbing, suspect at large
item.description: A man was stabbed in downtown Carlsbad and is being treated for serious injuries, with the suspect reportedly fleeing the scene before officers arrived.

item.title: Deputies search for suspect in Vista stabbing
item.description: Deputies are searching for a 21-year-old Hispanic man, around 5'5 with black hair, who is believed to have stabbed a victim in Vista and fled the scene.

item.title: Suspected DUI driver arrested after hit-and-run crash on I-5
item.description: A 19-year-old woman was struck by a Nissan Titan while possibly changing her tire on the I-5 near Camp Pendleton, suffering head injuries and multiple bone fractures.
